name: Braintree
label: Braintree — Braintree GraphQL (Braintree-Version 2019-01-01)
description: Official Braintree GraphQL (Braintree-Version 2019-01-01). Docs: https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/graphql/guides/making_api_calls. One node; operations via `operation`. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node. HARD PCI: cardholder data never enters the graph. Use processor tokens (pm_, nonce, encryptedCard, vault id) only. Never PAN, CVC, track data, or raw bank account numbers on INPUT/OUTPUT/logs. API keys are StudioQuack password secrets. POST /graphql with query+variables. Charge with paymentMethodId nonce from Drop-in / client SDK — never PAN. Sandbox: payments.sandbox.braintree-api.com. Sends header Braintree-Version: 2019-01-01. Purpose-oriented fields nest into GraphQL variables.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for Braintree. Secrets never on this port. HARD PCI: cardholder data never enters the graph. Use processor tokens (pm_, nonce, encryptedCard, vault id) only. Never PAN, CVC, track data, or raw bank account numbers on INPUT/OUTPUT/logs. API keys are StudioQuack password secrets.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: client_token_create | transaction_sale | transaction_void | transaction_refund | customer_create | subscription_create | trigger. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP.

schema.label: Environment
schema.description: Sandbox vs production GraphQL host. Substituted into api_spec baseUrl as https://{environment}. Example: payments.sandbox.braintree-api.com.

schema.label: query
schema.description: Official GraphQL document (body query). Example: mutation Charge($input: ChargePaymentMethodInput!) { chargePaymentMethod(input: $input) { transaction { id status } } }.

schema.label: variables
schema.description: GraphQL variables envelope escape hatch. Purpose fields paymentMethodId/transactionId/amount/customerId/… merge into variables via bodyMap. The GraphQL `query` document is still required.

schema.label: paymentMethodId
schema.description: Payment method id or nonce from Drop-in / client SDK (pm_ / fake-valid-nonce). NEVER a PAN. transaction_sale variables.paymentMethodId.

schema.label: amount
schema.description: transaction_sale / transaction_refund amount as a decimal string. Nested as variables.transaction.amount. Example: 10.00.

schema.label: customerId
schema.description: Vault customer id for sale / subscription / customer ops.

schema.label: email
schema.description: customer_create variables.customer.email. Not a card number.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: client_token_create | transaction_sale | transaction_void | transaction_refund | customer_create | subscription_create | trigger. Default client_token_create. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node.

configurationParameters.label: Private Key
configurationParameters.description: Braintree credential (basic Authorization). StudioQuack secret. Never INPUT, never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Environment
configurationParameters.description: Sandbox vs production GraphQL host. Substituted into api_spec baseUrl as https://{environment}. Example: payments.sandbox.braintree-api.com.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
